title: 第二章 景晖之誓
content_zh:
冉冉升起的朝阳，透过城门上的破洞，斜照进阴冷的门洞里。原本坚固的城门，在夜以继日地攻击下，早已残破不堪，一路修修补补才勉强坚持到了现在。

    城门后狭长的通道里，挤满了宋军，他们只能眼睁睁地看着城门，在雨军的攻击下，一点点地被破坏。

    巨斧砸在城门上，发出沉闷的声音，一下，两下，三下，仿佛在为宋军们敲响了最后的丧钟。

    早已千疮百孔的城门，再也承受不住攻击，轰然倒塌，重重地摔在地上，激起的灰尘，在通道内弥漫。

    宋军推动仅有的一辆刀车，朝城门冲去，想赶在宋军之前，将城门堵住。

    一个巨大的身影飞快地冲到刀车前，抡起巨斧直接劈向刀车。长久的交战，让双方的手段都是了若指掌。知道巨汉是由兵家士子，用秘法召唤出来力士，一般用来破城或者冲阵，这种简单而危险的活动。

    眼前的这种头戴黄巾，身上贴满符纸的力士，是最低级的一种，虽然力大无穷，可是智力却几乎为零，只能用来执行一些简单的任务。

    狭小的通道里，力士的作用被发挥到了极限，宋军完全无法发挥出人数优势，而拥挤的人群，也让宋军里的士不敢贸然向前。

    力士虽有一身蛮力，可巨斧挥舞的却毫无章法，身体不断地被宋军击中，象征生命力的符纸开始不断燃烧，可却没有一丝退缩，继续向前逼退宋军。

    巨汉的状态就是雨军此时的状态。兵家士子用秘法，将雨军士气化为力士，雨军无畏，力士便一往无前。雨军胆寒，则力士畏步不前。

    饱受攻击的力士，燃尽了最后一张符纸，在一声不甘的怒吼声中，化为劫灰飘散在天地之间。

    力士粗暴无惧的攻击，对宋军并未造成实质性的伤害。却为雨军赢得了宝贵的时间，他让宋军无法在第一时间，组织起有效的防御。

    对于宋军来说。机会稍纵即逝。激昂的战鼓声响起，雨军高喊着口号穿过城门，开进通道。

    军阵中盾例如墙，刀枪如林，泼箭如雨。

    雨军只是用箭矢逼退宋军，并未急于将他们歼灭，在盾墙的掩护下，缓缓地超前推进。

    宋雨之间，打到今天这个地步，双方早就没有了回旋的余地。昔日宋人对雨人的羞辱，雨人不能放过宋人，哪怕让宋人象征性地留下后裔，保留祭祀都不可能。

    在宋人眼里，雨人是窃国之贼，城中的宋人不可能向雨人求饶。战争持续到今天，要投降的早已投降，此刻还在坚持战斗的宋人，哪个不是和雨人有血海深仇。

    他们不会想到，宋人本身也是“窃国之贼”，而且是驱逐幼主，窃恩主之国。

    他们不会想到，他们为了一己私利，甚至让禹皇的布置，红尘的千年值守毁于一旦。

    他们到现在还在认为，雨人窃国。周边诸侯，目光短浅，落井下石对他们见死不救。

    雨军有条不紊地推进，一步步压缩宋军的空间，偶尔有几个自持武勇，想拼死一搏的宋军，也掀不起半点风浪，被无情收割后，割下首级，变为雨人的军功。

    攒够了军功的雨人，不光可以获得田地，还能获得爵位，分上几个奴隶，穿上绫罗绸缎，成为以前可望而不可即的贵族老爷。

    吴鹿城是宋人的祖陵所在，会稽城被丢后，祖庙就搬到了这里。在空旷的祖庙中，左卿一个人跪在牌位前，等待最后时刻的到来。稽城被夺后，宋公室只留下一个3岁的孩子，所有的事情就落在了他身上，尽管他已是花甲之年，可是对他解脱境的修为来说，应该算是正值当年。

    可五年的风风雨雨，耗尽了他的心神，“更始河之战”的旧伤，也时刻折磨着他。现在的他，一副老态龙钟的样子，身上的铠甲尽管改了又改，还是显得空荡。

    就在刚才他收到雨军已经进城的消息，当他听到这个消息时，长吁了一口气，压在身上的重担瞬间被卸下，他自己都想不到，会是如此的轻松。
content_en:
The rising sun slanted through the hole in the city gate and shone into the cold doorway. The originally strong city gate was already in dilapidated condition after being attacked day and night. It had to be repaired along the way and managed to survive until now.

    The long and narrow passage behind the city gate was crowded with Song troops. They could only watch as the city gate was destroyed bit by bit under the attack of the Yu army.

    The giant ax hit the city gate, making a dull sound, once, twice, three times, as if it sounded the final death knell for the Song army.

    The city gate, which was already riddled with holes, could no longer withstand the attack. It collapsed and fell heavily to the ground. The dust stirred up filled the passage.

    The Song army pushed the only sword cart and rushed towards the city gate, hoping to block the city gate before the Song army.

    A huge figure quickly rushed to the sword cart, swung a giant ax and struck directly at the sword cart. The long-term battle has made both sides well aware of their methods. We know that giant men are warriors summoned by strategists using secret methods. They are usually used to break cities or rush into formations, such simple but dangerous activities.

    The warriors in front of us, wearing yellow scarves and covered with talismans, are the lowest type. Although they are powerful, their intelligence is almost zero and they can only be used to perform some simple tasks.

    In the narrow passage, the role of the warriors was stretched to the limit. The Song army was completely unable to take advantage of its numerical advantage, and the crowded crowd also made the soldiers in the Song army dare not move forward rashly.

    Although the warrior had brute strength, he swung the giant ax without any plan. His body was continuously hit by the Song army, and the talisman symbolizing vitality began to burn continuously, but he did not flinch at all and continued to push forward to push back the Song army.

    The giant man's state is the same as Yujun's state at this time. The soldiers used secret methods to turn the morale of the Yu army into strong men. The Yu army was fearless and the strong men moved forward indomitably. If the rain army is timid, the warriors will be afraid to move forward.

    The heavily attacked warrior burned out the last piece of talisman, and with an unwilling roar, it turned into ashes and scattered between the heaven and the earth.

    The strong men's brutal and fearless attack did not cause any substantial damage to the Song army. But it bought valuable time for the Yu Army. He prevented the Song Army from organizing an effective defense in the first place.

    For Song Jun. Opportunities are fleeting. The passionate war drums sounded, and the rain army shouted slogans as they passed through the city gate and entered the passage.

    In the military formation, the shields are like walls, the swords and spears are like forests, and the arrows are like rain.

    The Yu army only used arrows to push back the Song army, but did not rush to annihilate them. They slowly advanced under the cover of the shield wall.

    The fight between Song and Yu has reached this point, and both sides have no room for maneuver. In the past, the Song people humiliated the Yu people. The Yu people could not let the Song people go. Even if they allowed the Song people to symbolically leave descendants and retain sacrifices, it was impossible.

    In the eyes of the Song people, Yu Ren was a thief who stole the country, and it was impossible for the Song people in the city to beg for mercy from Yu Ren. The war continues to this day, and those who wanted to surrender have already surrendered. The Song people who are still insisting on fighting at this moment have a blood feud with Rain Man.

    They would not have thought that the Song people themselves were also "thieves who stole the country", and they expelled the young master and stole the country from the benefactor.

    They would not have thought that for their own selfish interests, they would even let Emperor Yu's arrangement and the thousand-year watch in Hongchen be ruined.

    They still think that Rain Man stole the country. The surrounding princes were short-sighted and added insult to injury and refused to save them.

    The Rain Army advanced in an orderly manner, compressing the Song Army's space step by step. Occasionally, a few Song Army soldiers who were brave and wanted to fight to the death could not cause any trouble. After being ruthlessly harvested, their heads were cut off and became the military merits of the Rain People.

    A rain man who has accumulated enough military exploits can not only obtain land, but also obtain a title, be given a few slaves, wear silks and satins, and become an aristocratic lord that was previously unattainable.

    Wulucheng is where the ancestral mausoleum of the Song people is located. After Kuaiji City was lost, the ancestral temple was moved here. In the empty ancestral temple, Zuo Qing knelt alone in front of the tablet, waiting for the last moment to arrive. After Jicheng was captured, Song Gong's family only left a 3-year-old child, and everything fell on him. Although he was already in his sixties, for his cultivation in the liberation realm, he should be considered to be in his prime.

    But five years of ups and downs had exhausted his mind, and the old wounds of the "Battle of Gengshi River" were tormenting him all the time. He now looks very old, and even though the armor on his body has been changed again and again, it still looks empty.

    Just now he received the news that Yujun had entered the city. When he heard the news, he breathed a long sigh of relief, and the heavy burden on his body was instantly lifted. He never imagined that it would be so easy.
